patch_description: Restructures the filter as a modular, data-flow-oriented pipeline of independent stages (volatility model → forward Kalman → RTS smoother → multi-pass zero-phase SG → slope-lead compensation → light third SG polish → end-aligned trim). It reverts to the proven double-SG + lead-compensation core (which had far fewer slope changes and false reversals than the current blended-scale version) and adds a third unconditional light zero-phase SG pass (h = max(2, sg_half//3), order 2) to attack the remaining headroom in smoothness and false reversals, at negligible lag cost. Each stage is an isolated function, improving maintainability and allowing per-stage tuning.
